ns0:section.ns0:heading: Applications
ns0:section.ns0:chapeau: To request a grant under this part the chief local elected official of an area shall—

ns0:paragraph.ns0:content: prepare and submit to the Attorney General an application in such form, at such time, and in accordance with such procedures, as the Attorney General shall establish; and
provide an assurance that funds received under this part shall be used to supplement, not supplant, non-Federal funds that would otherwise be available for programs funded under this part.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Codification
ns0:note.ns0:p: Section was formerly classified to section 13774 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
